verdict.rationale: Square documents its own webhooks ('Subscribe to Event Notifications'), Payments, Invoices and Subscriptions APIs, and an official MCP server whose make_api_request tool lets an agent call the payments, invoices and customers services. So an agent could watch payment activity and act through the API. Nothing in the evidence shows failed-payment events, automated retry logic, or dunning workflows; the retry and outreach parts would have to be built by the agent. missing for 10: documented failed/declined payment webhook events, built-in or API-driven payment retry, dunning/outreach capability, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach
